WEEK 1 RULES
1. Never sit on chaos. Swap spare chaos to divines or the High watchlist items on day 1-3.
2. Speed matters: day 2 buys made roughly double what day 3 buys made last league.
3. Most items lose value in week 1. Only buy what is on the list.

DAY BY DAY
Day 1-2 (campaign): level meta gems in every spare socket, catch valuable beasts, start Kingsmarch, price-check every base, sell drops right away.
Day 3-5: farm the league mechanic plus Legion (or essences). Sell drops daily. Vaal or sell levelled gems.
Day 5-7: move into the scarab strategy that goes meta. Craft for popular builds. Start selling early investments as they peak.

SPLIT (from day 2)
40% High watchlist currency basket
30% scarabs for the meta strategy
30% divines (gear + atlas)
